_source: Secret stories (裏話): titles and unlock points read from the 「裏話出現!!」 popups in 神崎LEN's Japanese playthroughs (research/ocr/hunt/pops/secrets_read.md; built by research/secret_list.py), plus famille.gamerch.com. Each cost 5 crystals in Japan (the English edition charged energy for Aki's first). Only Aki 1 has English text and its English title; the others' titles are my translations and they play the placeholder. Aoi 5's title never appeared (its chapter is known from Aoi's Memory list); Aki 4 only in a Memory list; Misaki 7-10 weren't reached in the recordings.
